title: Privacy policy
html:
Fernwork is an online store owned and operated by Fernwork Home & Garden LLC. This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect when you visit our website, browse products, place an order or contact us, and how we use and protect it.

Information We Collect

Depending on how you use our store, we may collect:

  • Contact details: your name, email address, phone number and delivery address.
  • Order details: the products you buy, order totals and delivery preferences.
  • Messages: anything you send us through the contact form or by email.
  • Device and usage data: your browser type, pages viewed and approximate location, collected through cookies and similar technologies.

We do not store full payment card numbers. Payments are handled by our payment providers, who process your card details securely.

How We Use Your Information

  • To process and deliver your orders and keep you updated about them.
  • To answer questions and provide customer support.
  • To send plant-care tips and news if you subscribe to our emails. You can unsubscribe at any time.
  • To understand how the site is used and to improve our products and services.
  • To prevent fraud and to meet our legal obligations.

Who We Share It With

We share personal information only with service providers who help us run the store, such as payment processors, shipping carriers, website hosting and analytics providers. They may use your information only to provide their services to us. We do not sell your personal information.

Cookies

We use cookies and local storage to remember your cart, keep the site working and understand how it is used. You can control cookies through your browser settings, although some features may not work without them.

Keeping Your Information Safe

We take reasonable technical and organisational steps to protect your information. We keep it only for as long as needed to fulfil orders, meet legal requirements and resolve disputes.

Your Choices and Rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, or to object to certain uses of it. To make a request, please contact us at hello@fernwork.example.

Children

Our store is not intended for children under the age of majority in their jurisdiction, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our business or the law. The latest version will always be available on this page.

Contact Us

Email: hello@fernwork.example
